scope: All English and Punjabi overview, title, ten vocabulary entries, teach-back, caution and source labels; parent-authored passage studies are excluded from this review and are not imported into the final teaching part.
sourceScope: Ashtpadi 15, all84 Gurmukhi source occurrences, Ang282–283; selected lexical comparison with Professor Sahib Singh, Sri Guru Granth Darpan282–283.

findings.issue: Overview called all four comparisons comparisons of Shabad, while the source specifies Shabad, Guru feet/darshan and holy company across the pairings.
findings.resolution: Clarified the umbrella as the Guru’s support and named the distinct referents in both languages.

findings.issue: Vocabulary offered futility as one contextual meaning of birthaa in Pauri1; the immediate line is about not going empty from the Sustainer.
findings.resolution: Narrowed Pauri1 sense to empty-handed/disappointed, keeping pain/distress for the Salok in both languages.

outcome: Suitable as an original educational draft after the two adopted refinements; no other substantive source-fidelity issue found in the reviewed fields.
